scientific_scope.system: one fixed autonomous SU2 Unsteady NACA0012 attractor

phase_population.role_rule: k modulo 4 maps to train, development, prospective, sealed
phase_population.native_anchor_rule: map each nominal phase into the role's designated observed crossing interval and choose the nearest integer solver index; never interpolate a model state
phase_population.window_summary: compute each rollout's RMS error over the declared time window before aggregating across phase anchors; the terminal point is reported but never used alone because an integer-period horizon can alias a periodic orbit
phase_population.leakage_rule: every input history u_(n-1), current state u_n, and target through u_(n+208) must remain inside its role-owned frame block
phase_population.statistics: aggregate within each rollout, then report deterministic median, q90, and worst-phase summaries; do not bootstrap anchors as independent trajectories; report model seeds separately as optimization variability
phase_population.prior_access_exception: the solver-only phase qualification read the already generated 499--1999 prefix before this role split, without any model, model outcome, normalization, or method comparison; this is the sole pre-split whole-prefix exception and does not authorize Stage-2 access to prospective or sealed dynamic values

state_and_dataset.target: u_(n+1) - u_n computed in float64 before normalization or float32 casting
state_and_dataset.dataset_storage: the Stage-2 builder may read and export only train frames 955--1194 and development frames 1233--1472, each once; it may record prospective/sealed index ranges and pre-existing packet hashes but must not load, parse, copy, or derive from their dynamic values; a later reveal requires a separate owner-authorized materializer and receipt
state_and_dataset.diagnostic_replay_triplet: retain 497/498/499 as a separately labelled diagnostic-only triplet for the paired native-replay margin; exclude it from the ID population, normalization, training, checkpoint selection, and all support estimates

geometry.pcno_element_encoding: [2, n0, n1, n2, n3] for every quad
geometry.spectral_measure: one physical vertex-lumped area measure computed only by utility.time_dependent_no.su2_native_replay.lumped_vertex_areas, whose ordered-quad cell areas use the qualified polygon shoelace rule; auxiliary PCNO node_weights are m_i / sum_i m_i
geometry.quadrature_density: rho_i = node_weight_i / m_i = 1 / sum_i m_i for every positive-measure node; this repository-convention density is a constant static input on the fixed mesh and is distinct from the auxiliary normalized node_weights
geometry.normalized_coordinates: x_norm=(x-x_min)/(x_max-x_min) and y_norm=(y-y_min)/(y_max-y_min), with extrema computed once from the native mesh and recorded in the dataset manifest
geometry.fourier_coordinates: native coordinates translated by the mesh minimum: (x-x_min, y-y_min)
geometry.fourier_lengths: (x_max-x_min, y_max-y_min), recorded exactly by the dataset manifest
geometry.boundary_rule: static mesh boundary classes are allowed inputs; no future truth, boundary target, or oracle boundary value is an input

normalization.state: for field j, mu_j=mean over all train frames 955--1194 and all nodes; rms_j=sqrt(mean(u_j^2)); s_u_j=max(sqrt(mean((u_j-mu_j)^2)), 1e-8*max(rms_j,1)); the same mu_j and s_u_j normalize both history slots
normalization.state_scale_floor: the second argument in s_u_j above
normalization.residual: for field j over train transition centers 956--1193, s_delta_j=max(sqrt(mean((u_(n+1),j-u_n,j)^2)), 1e-6*s_u_j); all increments and statistics are constructed in float64
normalization.residual_scale_floor: the second argument in s_delta_j above
normalization.relative_l2_denominator_floor: ell_j=1e-12*max(rms_j,1); every fieldwise relative-L2 denominator is max(sum_i w_i*u_target_ij^2, ell_j^2)

model.input_layout: 2 normalized coordinates + 1 quadrature density + 3 boundary-class one-hot + 5 normalized previous-state fields + 5 normalized current-state fields
model.zero_initialization: set both backbone.fc2.weight and backbone.fc2.bias exactly to zero before the first optimizer step
model.recurrence: (u_(n-1), u_n) -> (u_n, u_n + s_delta * model(u_(n-1), u_n)) fieldwise
model.rollout_arithmetic: model inputs, model outputs, decoded residuals, and recurrent states are float32 on device; each predicted state is retained as float32 for the next step; reference states and predictions are converted to float64 only for metric accumulation and never fed back after conversion

training.precision: float32 without AMP; float64 target construction
training.loss: uniform-node MSE of the five normalized residual fields
training.scheduler: torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR with T_max=100 and eta_min=1e-5, stepped once after each completed training epoch
training.final_batch_policy: the final batch contains the remaining 2 of 238 transitions, is neither dropped nor repeated, uses a mean over its actual 2 examples, and receives one optimizer step
training.resource_only_adjustment: before production, a memory smoke may reduce the microbatch and add gradient accumulation while preserving effective batch 4; it may not change any scientific or optimization hyperparameter
training.presentations: every dense train transition exactly once per epoch in seed-deterministic shuffled order generated by a dedicated torch.Generator; DataLoader workers=0
training.reproducibility: seed Python random, NumPy, torch CPU, and all CUDA generators with the declared seed before model initialization; disable AMP and CUDA matmul/cuDNN TF32; set cuDNN benchmark=false and deterministic=true; PCNO CUDA scatter-add is not claimed bitwise deterministic, so torch deterministic-algorithm enforcement remains false and runtime/software/device identities are recorded
training.checkpoint_selection: at each checkpoint epoch compute R_n,uniform over all 238 dense development transitions, then take the median over n; replace the best checkpoint only on strict numeric decrease, so the earliest exact tie wins

evaluation.baseline: persistence under the identical population and views
evaluation.persistence_definition: for every BDF2 input pair, persistence predicts u_hat_(n+h)=u_n for every h>=1; it is evaluated with exactly the same fields, view weights, denominators, windows, anchors, and aggregation as PCNO

views.uniform_node: primary, w_i=1/N over all N nodes
views.near_body_wake_uniform_node: required diagnostic, w_i=1/N_view for nodes with x in [-1,10] and y in [-5,5], zero otherwise
views.physical_vertex_area: required secondary, w_i=m_i/sum_i m_i using the qualified shoelace/lumped m_i; cannot qualify alone

metric_definitions.dense_one_step_aggregation: compute transition metrics first, then report median, deterministic nearest-rank q90, and maximum across the 238 development transition centers; each-field adequacy uses median_n R_(n,uniform,j), and checkpoint score uses median_n R_(n,uniform)
metric_definitions.rollout_window: W_(a,l,r,v)=sqrt((1/(r-l+1))*sum_(h=l..r) E_(a,h,v)^2) when every state in that anchor/window is finite; set W=+infinity for any anchor whose window is not fully finite before deterministic median, nearest-rank q90, and maximum aggregation, and also report a separately labelled finite-anchor-only summary
metric_definitions.finite_state_rate: for a seed and horizon r, sum over the eight anchors of the number of consecutively produced finite states among steps 1--r, divided by 8*r; the first nonfinite state and all later unproduced states count as incomplete
metric_definitions.full_rollout_completion_rate: for a seed and horizon r, count anchors whose every predicted state at h=1..r is finite, divided by 8; this anchor completion fraction, not finite_state_rate, enters R0 gates
metric_definitions.one_step_rollout_value: E1=median across the eight development anchors of E_(a,1,uniform)
metric_definitions.terminal_horizons: report E and L at h in {1,35,104,208}; these endpoints are secondary and never replace the frozen early/late window functionals
metric_definitions.train_template_nearest_phase: at registered terminal horizons, minimize E_scale under the requested view over every train frame 955--1194; report the minimum, nearest train-frame index, its phase, the time-matched E, and their difference
metric_definitions.boundary_error: on airfoil and farfield node sets separately, use uniform weights over that boundary set and the same per-field s_u_j and equal-field E_scale formula
metric_definitions.wall_normal_momentum_leakage: construct each airfoil vertex normal by normalizing the length-weighted sum of its incident outward body-edge normals; with s_m=sqrt((s_u_Momentum_x^2+s_u_Momentum_y^2)/2), report RMS over airfoil vertices of ((m_hat-m_true) dot n)/s_m and the analogous absolute predicted and reference RMS values
metric_definitions.admissibility: at every finite predicted state report node fractions and first step for rho<=0, internal energy E-(Momentum_x^2+Momentum_y^2)/(2*rho)<=0, and Nu_Tilde<0; division-derived diagnostics are marked invalid at rho<=0 but the finite recurrent state is not altered and rollout continues
metric_definitions.volume_integral: I_j=sum_i w_(physical,i)*u_(i,j); report abs(I_hat_j-I_j)/s_u_j per field and their equal-field RMS
metric_definitions.pressure_only_force: with gamma=1.4, p=(gamma-1)*(Energy-(Momentum_x^2+Momentum_y^2)/(2*Density)); for each ordered airfoil marker edge (a,b), choose the unit normal n_e pointing away from the arithmetic centroid of unique airfoil vertices and length L_e, then F_p=-sum_e 0.5*(p_a+p_b)*n_e*L_e; project onto d=(cos(17 deg),sin(17 deg)) and l=(-sin(17 deg),cos(17 deg)); report raw drag/lift proxies and errors divided by train-only s_F=max(std_train(F),1e-8*max(rms_train(F),1)); this pressure-only five-state diagnostic is distinct from the qualified native replay's pressure-plus-skin-friction proxy

one_step_metrics: component-balanced relative L2 of next state
evaluation.invalid_rollout_policy: stop only at the first nonfinite state; continue finite but physically inadmissible states and report their first occurrence and rate
evaluation.force_label: pressure-only state-derived proxy, not the qualified replay pressure-plus-skin-friction proxy and not producer-integrated SU2 lift or drag

native_replay_margin.stage: paired post-training R0 readiness check; it is not used for training or checkpoint selection
native_replay_margin.model_input_and_target: apply each selected clean PCNO to diagnostic-only histories (u_497,u_498) to predict u_499 and compare with the canonical five-field u_499 target
native_replay_margin.metric: component-balanced five-field next-state relative L2 using the same per-view formula and denominator floors defined above
native_replay_margin.gate: for every seed and each of the three views, qualified_native_replay_error_v < 0.25*PCNO_error_seed_v at exactly the 497/498-to-499 interface
native_replay_margin.scope: this check establishes only a model-relative numerical margin at the qualified replay interface; the triplet is outside the declared attractor ID population and cannot support an ID-generalization or arbitrary-state-restart claim
native_replay_margin.later_intervention_margin: before interpreting B4 method separations, a separate frozen comparison must also show native replay discrepancy below one quarter of the smallest interpreted separation

adequately_trained_per_seed: development median uniform-node component-balanced next-state relative L2 <= 0.05
development q90 uniform-node component-balanced next-state relative L2 <= 0.10
R0_decision_rule.initially_accurate: development-anchor median W_(a,1,35,uniform) is < 0.15, is <=0.80 times the identically aggregated persistence value, and every one of the eight anchors completes all 35 steps finitely
R0_decision_rule.severe_long_horizon: development-anchor median W_(a,174,208,uniform), with failed windows assigned +infinity, is >= max(0.25,5*E1), or full_rollout_completion_rate(208)<0.80
R0_decision_rule.reproducibility: all three seeds pass adequate training and at least two of three pass both initially accurate and severe long-horizon rules
R0_decision_rule.reject_if_no_failure: if the frozen 208-step development horizon does not expose reproducible severe delayed degradation, reject NACA0012 as the hero correction-necessity case under this contract; do not extend after observing the outcome
R0_decision_rule.not_sufficient_for_primary_promotion: a passing baseline phenotype still requires train-only support structure and evidence that failure is not only phase error, solver bias, undertraining, or boundary leakage
